name: Nagishiro Miyako
source:
Grade: 2nd year, Sakura Group
Affiliation: The gardening club

Miyako is [url=/c13086]Akira[/url] and [url=/c13087]Akiko[/url]’s osananajimi and the latter's classmate. She’s a flower freak just like Akiko, and also is a member of the gardening club. Miyako is a tsundere, so she gets especially hostile towards Akira, the person she is fond of. Not so to the other people though. She’s also from a rich family.

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
